summary: This week in AI, significant advancements were made in chip design, AI-powered medicine, and cybersecurity. NVIDIA harnessed the Vera CPU to speed up design, while Google committed $40M to the Genesis Mission. OpenAI's new voice mode and Anthropic's Opus 5 launch showcased AI's growing capabilities.
insight: The intersection of AI and cybersecurity is becoming increasingly critical, as evidenced by the proposed AI Kill Switch Act and the hacking incident involving OpenAI and Hugging Face, highlighting the need for robust security measures in AI development.
highlights: NVIDIA's use of Vera CPU to accelerate chip design
OpenAI's launch of ChatGPT Health, allowing users to connect medical records
Anthropic's release of Opus 5, offering cheaper and less restrictive AI capabilities
